phases.objective: Refresh the fail-closed Ed25519 schema attestation so it binds all four governed migrations, including Durable Authorized Injection State, and the exact version-4 same-cycle readback without accessing a live database or committing signing material.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: A synthetically signed exact schema subject verifies only when all four migration ledger rows, version-4 readback counts, runtime parity, database identity, signer policy, public-key fingerprint, and freshness match; production readiness and operational authority remain false.
steps: Build a canonical secret-free schema subject from the four exact governed migration ledger rows.
Bind the subject to the exact repository source commit and deployed runtime SHA.
Bind version-4 same-cycle readback to 17 compatible tables, three views, 68 runtime columns, 31 index positions, and three disabled tools.
Require the two Durable Authorized Injection tables and their state, rollback, digest, uniqueness, and foreign-key surfaces in the readback contract.
Hash the normalized migration and readback evidence independently before hashing the complete subject.
Generate an ephemeral Ed25519 key pair inside the test process and sign only the canonical signature payload.
Verify the signature with the public JWK and require the exact allowed key fingerprint, signer identity, issuer, freshness, signing delay, and readback duration.

Reject the retired version-3 readback identity, a three-wave ledger, Wave 4 non-apply evidence, private JWK input, tampered subjects, invalid signatures, stale evidence, runtime drift, database mismatch, incomplete readback, and sensitive fields.
Prove no live database access, migration execution, provider dispatch, deployment, Production mutation, authority grant, or committed private key occurred.
assertions: Schema verification becomes true only after a valid Ed25519 signature over the exact canonical subject digest.
All four migration filenames, checksums, statement counts, apply modes, success statuses, and ledger evidence digests are required.
The readback contract identity is spec014_hostinger_storage_migration_readback_v4 and the retired v3 identity fails closed.
Runtime source and deployed SHA parity is mandatory when the policy requires it.
Readback must prove all 17 expected tables, three views, 68 runtime columns, 31 index positions, and default-off tools with zero provider calls, protected payload reads, external writes, or secrets.
A valid schema signature does not set production_ready, grant authority, authorize migration apply, or permit provider dispatch.
No private key material or live schema evidence is committed by this change.

phases.objective: Operational signing requires a separately governed signer and live same-cycle database readback after all four migrations have exact Apply ledger evidence.
Signer rotation, transparency logging, and retry handling belong to the later operational signing vehicle.
No live database or provider canary is executed by this contract refresh.
Production schema verification remains false until live Apply, version-4 same-cycle readback, and an authorized external signature complete.
